title: Squabetty

services.name: Surf and wake
services.desc: The shuffleboard court we have now was put in by our grandparents in 1935. Technically, my grandfather called it a shuffleboard run. It was resurfaced in 1955. It’s had a long life…which was beginning to show the wrinkles and cracks of age once again. At least one guest reported pucks going in odd directions or jumping down the court. Time for a little work. Shuffleboard began in the 1400s in English Taverns, where pucks would slide down long wooden tables. Word has it the game became so popular that Henry VIII banned the sport so troops could focus on archery. blurb: Tucked under Vermont’s tallest mountain, on several hundred acres, Squabetty provides an escape parallel to none. It is the perfect spot for mountain weddings, reunions, family vacations and retreats. We have yet to find anyone who hasn't been charmed by her history and her location. We know you will find her magic too.
